stem: The image supports which statement about U.S. society during the early 1900s?

options.label: F
options.text: New technologies made daily life easier for consumers.

options.label: G
options.text: Consumers resisted change in favor of traditional products.

options.label: H
options.text: Harmful economic cycles caused consumers to resist new technology.

options.label: J
options.text: The manufacture of new products encouraged consumers to stay home.
